bus_routes.description: The temple is approximately 2 km from Hanamkonda Bus Station according to the Hanumakonda District government website. Local buses, autos, and taxis are readily available.
Regular road services connect Hyderabad and Warangal/Hanamkonda. Journey takes approximately 3 hours depending on traffic.
Warangal is well connected by road to Karimnagar, Khammam, Vijayawada, Bengaluru, Chennai, Tirupati, and others.

stations.description: Situated on the major Secunderabad–Vijayawada mainline.
Critical national junction connecting major North and South India rail networks.

railway.last_mile_transit: Local auto-rickshaws, shared vehicles, and app-based cabs operate continuously outside both station exits.

airport.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD)
airport.description: The nearest airport is located in Hyderabad, approximately 150 km away from the temple site.
